response.rationale: A and B look like the same business concept, an ice-rink session, under two names. In ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c, src/business/reportService.ts), the loop `for (const s of this.sessions.list()) {` goes through the injected SessionRepository, since the graph shows ReportService constructor-injects SessionRepository and calls its list method. SessionRepository (node e3915d8f30e495a9, src/persistence/sessionRepository.ts) stores those same objects in `private readonly sessions = new Map<string, Session>();`. So "Session" in reporting and "Ice Session" in persistence refer to one Session entity. Other callers in the graph, such as IceMonitorService.recordReading and RinkService.createSession and cancelSession, confirm that this is the rink's ice session.
